title: AI Practitioner | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: AI Practitioner. Category: Development. Duration: 2 months. Description: The AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01) Program: a certification-focused course covering AI and machine learning fundamentals, generative AI, and AWS AI services. Eligibility: Intermediate. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
